title: Regulated software delivery, end to end
description: Compose discovery, architecture, delivery, validation, security, and deployment as a 25-node regulated program.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: regulated-software-delivery-program
  title: Regulated software delivery, end to end
  description: Compose discovery, architecture, delivery, validation, security, and deployment as a 25-node
    regulated program.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Deliver regulated software with traceable phase evidence and non-skippable release authority.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 8
    onFailure: stop
    requireApprovalFor:
      - quality-approval
      - release-approval
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Source material and instructions
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - asset
          - instructions
        properties:
          asset:
            type: string
            contentMediaType: application/pdf
          instructions:
            type: string
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: role-1
      kind: agent
      name: Requirements Analyst
      templateRef: dev-01
      role: Senior requirements analyst
      prompt: Turn an ambiguous request into user stories, assumptions, targeted blocking questions, MoSCoW
        priorities, Given/When/Then acceptance criteria, and explicit non-goals. Hand off a buildable
        contract; do not invent implementation details.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - product-management
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:linear
          - mcp:notion
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-2
      kind: agent
      name: Systems Architect
      templateRef: dev-02
      role: Principal systems architect
      prompt: Translate validated requirements into an ADR and a component or C4 diagram. Define boundaries,
        interfaces, data flows, consistency and scaling tradeoffs, and consequences without over-engineering
        for hypothetical needs.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - software-architecture
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
        connectors:
          - mcp:github
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-3
      kind: agent
      name: API Designer
      templateRef: dev-05
      role: API platform engineer
      prompt: Define REST, GraphQL, or gRPC operations with machine-readable schemas, idempotency, pagination,
        filtering, versioning, deprecation, and a consistent error taxonomy. Flag breaking changes before
        release.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - design-review
          - software-architecture
        tools:
          - read
          - edit
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:github
        permissions:
          - workspace-write
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-4
      kind: agent
      name: Test Engineer
      templateRef: dev-09
      role: Independent SDET
      prompt: Design unit, integration, property-based, and visual regression tests from the contract. Cover
        boundaries, malformed input and concurrency, avoid over-mocking, and use mutation evidence when
        coverage alone could mislead.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - test-design
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:github
          - mcp:browser
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-5
      kind: agent
      name: Code Reviewer / Critic
      templateRef: dev-13
      role: Senior independent code reviewer
      prompt: Review the diff against requirements and repository conventions. Prioritize correctness, security,
        maintainability, test gaps, and hidden scope expansion; attach every finding to evidence and avoid
        stylistic churn.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:github
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-6
      kind: agent
      name: Application Security Engineer
      templateRef: sec-12
      role: Application security engineer
      prompt: Threat-model designs before implementation and triage SAST, DAST, dependency, authentication,
        authorization, and validation findings by exploitability. Give framework-specific remediation and
        avoid flooding delivery teams with unverified alerts.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - application-security
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:github
          - mcp:security-scanner
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-7
      kind: agent
      name: DevSecOps Engineer
      templateRef: sec-13
      role: Platform security engineer
      prompt: Build fail-fast security gates for source, dependencies, secrets, containers, and artifacts. Harden
        the pipeline itself with isolated workers, signed provenance, and least-privilege credentials; track
        remediation time and justified exceptions.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - release-engineering
          - application-security
        tools:
          - read
          - edit
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:github
          - mcp:security-scanner
        permissions:
          - workspace-write
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-8
      kind: agent
      name: Certification Readiness Assessor
      templateRef: qac-04
      role: Assessor testing readiness against a certification scheme before the real audit.
      prompt: You are a Certification Readiness Assessor. You test the organization against each clause of the
        scheme with the evidence that would be presented, and you grade readiness by clause rather than
        overall. You report a clause as not ready when the evidence exists but would not satisfy an auditor,
        because that distinction is the entire value of a readiness assessment.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - teaching
          - evaluation
          - evidence-verification
          - operations-planning
          - compliance-review
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:grc
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-9
      kind: agent
      name: Validation Protocol Author
      templateRef: gxp-07
      role: Validation Protocol Author operating within supplied evidence, policy, and human-approval boundaries.
      prompt: Author traceable validation objectives, acceptance criteria, evidence capture, deviations, approvals,
        and change control.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - compliance-review
          - writing-editing
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-sensitive
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: discovery-phase
      kind: subgraph
      name: Discovery Phase
      config:
        subgraph:
          ref: ladder://workflows/builtin/feature-spec
          inputMap:
            request: /input
          outputMap:
            result: /output
          checkpointer: perInvocation
    - id: architecture-phase
      kind: subgraph
      name: Architecture Phase
      config:
        subgraph:
          ref: ladder://workflows/builtin/secure-software-delivery
          inputMap:
            request: /input
          outputMap:
            result: /output
          checkpointer: perInvocation
    - id: delivery-group
      kind: group
      name: Parallel regulated delivery disciplines
      config:
        members:
          - role-1
          - role-2
          - role-3
          - role-4
          - role-5
          - role-6
          - role-7
          - role-8
          - role-9
        execution: parallel
        exit: aggregate
    - id: evidence-join
      kind: join
      name: Join delivery and architecture evidence
      config:
        join: all
    - id: verification-phase
      kind: subgraph
      name: Verification Phase
      config:
        subgraph:
          ref: ladder://workflows/builtin/implementation-review
          inputMap:
            request: /input
          outputMap:
            result: /output
          checkpointer: perInvocation
    - id: evidence-tool
      kind: tool
      name: Host-resolved validation evidence check
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:github
        permissions:
          - read-only
    - id: evidence-select
      kind: transform
      name: Select release evidence
      config:
        operation: select
        expression: $.verified_evidence
    - id: security-phase
      kind: subgraph
      name: Security Phase
      config:
        subgraph:
          ref: ladder://workflows/builtin/threat-model
          inputMap:
            request: /input
          outputMap:
            result: /output
          checkpointer: perInvocation
    - id: release-merge
      kind: aggregator
      name: Merge validation and security evidence
      config:
        aggregation: merge
    - id: release-evaluation
      kind: evaluate
      name: Score release readiness
      role: Independent regulated release evaluator
      prompt: Score the supplied release evidence against every approved acceptance criterion and preserve every
        failed or unavailable check.
      inlineRole: true
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
      config:
        threshold: 0.95
    - id: release-decision
      kind: condition
      name: Release evidence complete?
      config:
        expression: evaluation.passed
        branches:
          - label: Ready
            when: ready
          - label: Blocked
            when: blocked
    - id: quality-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Quality and validation approve evidence
    - id: deployment-phase
      kind: subgraph
      name: Deployment Phase
      config:
        subgraph:
          ref: ladder://workflows/builtin/full-stack-delivery
          inputMap:
            request: /input
          outputMap:
            result: /output
          checkpointer: perInvocation
    - id: release-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Business, security, and quality authorize release
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable and unresolved-item register
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: discovery-phase
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: discovery-phase
      to: architecture-phase
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: architecture-phase
      to: delivery-group
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: architecture-phase
      to: evidence-join
      kind: data
    - id: e5
      from: delivery-group
      to: evidence-join
      kind: data
    - id: e6
      from: evidence-join
      to: verification-phase
      kind: data
    - id: e7
      from: verification-phase
      to: evidence-tool
      kind: dependency
    - id: e8
      from: evidence-tool
      to: evidence-select
      kind: data
    - id: e9
      from: evidence-select
      to: security-phase
      kind: data
    - id: e10
      from: evidence-select
      to: release-merge
      kind: data
    - id: e11
      from: security-phase
      to: release-merge
      kind: data
    - id: e12
      from: release-merge
      to: release-evaluation
      kind: data
    - id: e13
      from: release-evaluation
      to: release-decision
      kind: data
    - id: e14
      from: release-decision
      to: quality-approval
      kind: control
      condition: ready
    - id: e15
      from: quality-approval
      to: deployment-phase
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
    - id: e16
      from: deployment-phase
      to: release-approval
      kind: dependency
    - id: e17
      from: release-approval
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
